description: First flight 15/08/1968, delivered 22/08/1968. Flew with the Central Flying School and the Roulettes in 1981, 1982, 1988 and 1989 and with No. 76 Squadron, then allocated to No. 25 (City of Perth) Squadron for promotional use. Restored in 2 FTS orange and white and displayed as gate guard near the security gate (ADF-Serials).
aliases: MB326; MB326H; Macchi; CA-30; CA30; c/n CA30-27
